definitions.explanation: Insurance that provides a monetary payout upon the policyholder's death or after a specified period. One of the most common types of insurance in Japan.

examples.japanese: {生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧。
⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}した→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: I reviewed my life insurance when I got married.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated to {生保|せいほ} in casual speech and business contexts. Japan has one of the highest life insurance penetration rates in the world. Many workers purchase life insurance through their employer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加入|かにゅう}する→加入する：22671_kanyuusuru⟧ (to take out life insurance)
- {生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}{会社|がいしゃ} (life insurance company)
- {生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}{料|りょう} (life insurance premium)
